title: Make a styled code animation with a picked prompt
summary: XiaoyeCodes packaged 341 animation style prompts as a Claude Code and Codex skill so the agent plans shots and renders a coded video to MP4.
agent_role: The agent reads a chosen style prompt, writes the animation as HTML, and renders it frame-by-frame to an MP4 video.
what_they_did: The author collected 341 animation style prompts and 193 reference frames and wrapped them as an installable skill. You pick a style, then ask the coding agent to build a short animation as HTML and render it to video.
worth_knowing: Rendering needs Playwright, Chromium and FFmpeg; the HTML must expose a time interface so frames can be exported, so arbitrary web pages won't work.
prompt: Install https://github.com/XiaoyeCodes/code-animation-prompts as a skill for my coding agent, then use style [B3 particle formation] to make a 12-second [16:9] animation about [your theme]. Build an editable HTML file and a keyframe preview first, show me the result, then render an MP4 at [1920x1080, 30 fps] if the rendering tools are installed.

curation.rationale: A packaged skill with a concrete workflow: pick an animation style, have the agent build and render a coded video; includes working prompts and an example.
